newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,511 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,511 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 1,511 contracts compared with 1,129 overnight Thursday.
There were 128 wheat, 599 corn, 717 soybean, 35 soymeal, 16 soyoil, four corn calls, one soybean call and 11 soybean puts were traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 2-1/2 to four cents lower, corn was 1/2 to one cent lower and soybens were 5-3/4 to 11-1/4 cents lower.
